card.name: Comma after hepatitis in DRESS lists
card.fires_on: The comma right after "hepatitis" in the list of organ involvement in DRESS-type warnings (hepatitis, nephritis, hematological abnormalities). Also the "atic" in "acute hepatic necrosis" in adverse-reaction lists.

modes.label: Comma after hepatitis
modes.description: List comma following hepatitis in a sentence about organ system involvement with fever, rash and lymphadenopathy.
modes.example: in association with other organ system involvement, such as hepatitis<<,>> nephritis, hematological abnormalities, myocard

modes.label: Hepatic necrosis
modes.description: The ending of "hepatic" in a list of allergic and organ reactions.
modes.example: Hepatitis; jaundice; acute hep<<atic>> necrosis or failure; Anemia,
